normal_source_order: rubric_or_simplex > Recipe/ingredient/measure > preparation > medium > state > application > storage
compression_mechanism: contractions, suspensions, recipe signs, repeated formulae, omitted idem arguments
main_strength: Short, conventional and easy to excerpt from antidotaries
strongest_failure: Open illustrated articles contain a large rare tail and need more than a tiny formula deck

normal_source_order: owner_or_ailment > take > prepare > add_medium > strain_or_stand > apply > keep
compression_mechanism: imperative repetition, pronoun/idem omission, ordinary vernacular abbreviations
main_strength: Best match to continuous take-do-apply recipe flow
strongest_failure: Too verbose to explain the surviving compression without a second compiler stage

compression_mechanism: fixed fields, marks and copied local labels
main_strength: Explains picture ownership and exact copying
strongest_failure: Weak for fifteen open fields, article reflow and plant-specific rare content

normal_source_order: rubric > Recipe/charge > measure > vessel_or_target > temper/filter/apply > drain > fiat_or_close
compression_mechanism: short formulae, ana/idem/praedictum-style carry, recipe and measure signs
main_strength: Can state repeated process operations economically
strongest_failure: Does not by itself explain 85/115 locally closed cells or apparatus-shaped parallelism

normal_source_order: prepare > put > warm > lead > wash_or_bathe > drain > repeat
compression_mechanism: short imperatives, omitted repeated objects, parataxis
main_strength: Historically ordinary and readable by non-university practitioners
strongest_failure: Needs severe abbreviation to fit one-card and two-card work cells

compression_mechanism: whole-card cells, anonymous register carry, closure marks
main_strength: Best direct match to short cells, repeated values and apparatus workflow
strongest_failure: Cannot independently supply water, patient, body, vessel, disease or operation nouns

normal_source_order: title > planet/sign rule > conditions > local election sentence
compression_mechanism: formulaic headings and abbreviated condition clauses
strongest_failure: Poor direct fit to hundreds of short spatial labels and no decoded Latin remains

normal_source_order: choose lord > find sign/station > check condition > act_or_defer
main_strength: Plausible teaching gloss for a practitioner
strongest_failure: No need for full vernacular prose in a spatial lookup instrument

normal_source_order: local address > externally learned inventory label > local rule
compression_mechanism: spatial position, copied labels, diagram-local codebook
main_strength: Best direct fit to 7/12/28 lookup instruments
strongest_failure: External names, start, direction and rule values remain exemplar-dependent

normal_source_order: ordinary Latin or vernacular technical source > picture/register ellipsis > common whole-card deck plus copied local tail > register template
compression_mechanism: ordinary abbreviation plus learned brevigraphs, exemplars, anonymous registers and renderer

strongest_failure: Requires a local codebook/exemplar that has not survived independently and cannot be reconstructed semantically from the pages alone
